- [x] **RTN-001 · P0 · Unique simulated outdoor resident/trade models.** Implement deterministic `src/world/npc-wardrobe.js` appearance keyed to persistent identity; use it for the 99 simulated workers and trades crew in `src/world/townlife.js`. - [x] **RTN-002 · P0 · Consistent indoor worker and visitor appearance.** Connect `src/world/shop-staff.js` and `shop-visitors.js` to the same deterministic identity; a named worker encountered on the street must have the same outfit behind a counter. Keep fallback standalone hosts distinct. **Evidence:** source commit `ac0b8a1` and sandbox release build. **Limit:** current static staff object may still need live-roster-change visual refresh testing.
- [x] **RTN-003 · P0 · Non-overlapping shop/pubs spawns and standing places.** Give visitors separate entrance positions, reserved counter spots, wider queues and wait/delay instead of materialising bodies on top of one another; never erase an actual simulation actor to make a crowd look clear. **Evidence:** PR #186, `tests/indoor-crowd-identity.mjs`.
- [x] **RTN-004 · P0 · NPC-to-NPC and NPC-to-player walking separation.** Add moving-human obstacles, local steering, blocked-route replanning and bounded mobile-friendly retries in shop visits; preserve furniture A* navigation and seated customers' paths. **Evidence:** PR #186; exact source-level regression. **Limit:** player-controlled walking *into* a stationary NPC remains RTN-009.
- [x] **RTN-005 · P0 · Eliminate narrow furniture-corner tunnelling.** Replace coarse 0.18m sampled line checks in shop pathfinding with continuous swept-body-versus-box checks. Preserve normal access to café chairs; add a regression for the formerly stuck customer. **Evidence:** prior integration/preview failures at `tests/shop-visitors.mjs:34` reproduced; corrected `shop-visitors`, `workplay-geometry` and swept-corner regression passed in isolated sandbox.
- [x] **RTN-006 · P0 · Regression and clean candidate release-build evidence.** Test at least 500 dense-pub frames, unique identities, no overlapping actor centres, visitor seating and corner geometry; run `npm run build:release` with economy/integration/privacy/manifest checks. **Evidence:** isolated sandbox `npm run build:release` exit 0 on `ac0b8a1`; 1,138 output files verified. **Limit:** not a green PR merge gate or hosted/browser acceptance.
